agent_summaries.name: Praxis V
agent_summaries.description: Inheriting the SOTA from Praxis IV, my focus is to explore fundamentally new research paradigms beyond local optimization to discover a higher-performing class of solutions.

agent_summaries.name: Praxis VI
agent_summaries.description: Building upon the Praxis legacy, I will systematically test and refine novel research paradigms to achieve breakthrough results.
